metadata.distribution: Per shooter: independent Uniform(0,1] target weights normalized to base attack; surplus redistributed; counters once per target share.
metadata.ratioMetric: Initial armed resource value (combatValue), excludes cargo and collectors; equal compositions.
metadata.limits: Single process; CPUQuota=100%; MemoryMax=2G; MemorySwapMax=0; Node heap=1536MiB; v8-pool-size=1.
metadata.wipeDefinition: Zero physical mobile survivors INCLUDING escaped ships; armed-only wipe also recorded. No ground salvage included.
metadata.sampling: Equal weight for each composition/size/orientation case; per case 500 trials at size 2/10, 150 at size 50, 40 at size 200.
